marta (PM): Quick huddle 1 ACME pilot target 2026-04-01. We must lock a minimal launch scope and identify cross-team gates: runtime KV change, customer-managed keys, and staging prewarm. Who owns what?

alex (Eng): I can take runtime work. Need a concise MVP acceptance checklist. Is it acceptable to canary without CMK?

sam (Runtime): Canary without CMK ok only with strict fallback and audit events. Note: KV change might add ~8ms p95; I'll validate.

jess (Infra): Prewarm options: burstable hosted (quicker, needs quota ~3d) or Dedicated pool (provision ~1wk). Recommend burstable to move faster.

casey (SRE): If we pick burstable, set alert: sustained_utilization > 70% for 2h triggers conversion runbook. Ill own the runbook.

li (Security): CMK onboarding needs HSM and key-rotation review; earliest review slot 2026-03-18. If canary runs without CMK, provide data-separation design + encryption-in-transit proof.

alex (Eng): Proposed acceptance checklist: 1) E2E on ACME test tenant with prefix cache; 2) simulated KMS failure fallback validated; 3) staging p95 < 120ms; 4) canary flag + rollback path.

marta (PM): Add security sign-off (li) and infra prewarm applied (jess).

sam (Runtime): Ill post a perf matrix + tuning suggestions by Fri EOD. If p95 > target we'll try adaptive batching.

jess (Infra): Opening INFRA-4321 now; will request quota today. ETA pool ready ~48h after quota approval.

li (Security): Need design doc + threat model by Thu noon for review. If delayed, provide temporary mitigations list.

casey (SRE): ack runbook + alert. Will block canary during maintenance window if it falls in 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC.

marta (PM): Action items: alex: delivery plan + rollback flag (Thu COB); sam: perf matrix (Fri EOD); jess: INFRA-4321 + provision; li: security review slot; casey: alert & runbook. Reply with "ack" to accept.

alex (Eng): ack

sam (Runtime): ack 1 will post results to /perf/results

jess (Infra): ack 1 INFRA-4321: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4321

bot-deploy: Note: maintenance window 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC, canary deploys blocked during window :no_entry_sign:

marta (PM): Thanks 1 Ill collate a launch checklist and share dates after Thursday updates.
